title: Nighttime Sunwatch
text:
🌕 Nighttime Sunwatch — October 17, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B8.8​)
🔥 Latest solar flare: C1.2 (Peaked October 17, 2026 at 06:30 UTC)
🔥 Strongest recent flare: C6.0 (Peaked October 16, 2026 at 19:14 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 450 km/s (Elevated)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 1.00)

Sunny spotted a flare! 🔥🌌

A broad coronal-hole feature and two active regions are visible today, while the coronagraph shows no clearly notable outward structure.

Image: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 171 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
